sl.name: Jivie
sl.subtitle: Opravila, načrti in nakupi
sl.short_description: Opravila, dogodki, nakupi, finance in vrt. Tvoj vsakdan na enem mestu.
sl.promotional_text: Začni z osebnimi opravili na napravi. Uredi načrte, nakupovalne sezname in izdatke ter pripravi šifrirano varnostno kopijo.
sl.description:
Jivie združuje opravila, domače projekte, dogodke, nakupe, finance in vrt. Začni brez računa: osebne podatke ustvarjaš in urejaš na napravi tudi brez internetne povezave.

TVOJ VSAKDAN NA ENEM MESTU
• Na zaslonu Danes preglej opravila in dogodke.
• Uredi projekte, faze, mejnike in roke opravil.
• Pripravi nakupovalne sezname z artikli in količinami.
• Beleži prihodke in stroške ter pripravi mesečni finančni načrt. Strošek lahko povežeš z opravilom.
• Načrtuj vrt, nariši grede ter beleži sezone in zasaditve.
• Vključi lokalne opomnike za opravila in dogodke.
• Ustvari šifrirano prenosno kopijo ter pred obnovo preveri njeno vsebino.
• Izberi slovenščino ali angleščino ter svetlo ali temno temo.

SODELOVANJE PO TVOJI IZBIRI
Za sinhronizacijo naprav in skupno delo poveži združljiv strežnik Kanboard z vtičnikom FamilyHub. Uporabljaš lahko zasebni prostor, skupno gospodinjstvo ali deljene projekte. Dostop do skupnih zapisov in financ določajo pravice prostora. Pregled Vsi združi podatke iz prostorov, do katerih imaš dostop.

Za nov račun potrebuješ kodo upravitelja ali povabilo. Prijava sama ne prenese osebnih podatkov; prenos vključiš izrecno. Vrt je trenutno shranjen samo na napravi in je vključen v prenosne kopije.

OBVESTILA IN OPOMNIKI
Center obvestil spremlja skupno dogajanje in osebne dodelitve. Oddaljena potisna obvestila zahtevajo dodatno združljivo strežniško in mobilno konfiguracijo; samostojno gostovanje samo po sebi ne zagotavlja dostave ob zaprti aplikaciji. Lokalni opomniki imajo omejitve operacijskega sistema in lahko zamujajo.

Jivie je brezplačna aplikacija. Gostovanje ni vključeno. Sinhronizacija ni varnostna kopija strežnika; prenosna kopija ne vsebuje priponk ali podatkov, ki jih naprava še ni prenesla.

en.name: Jivie
en.subtitle: Tasks, plans and shopping
en.short_description: Tasks, events, shopping, finances and gardening. Everyday life in one place.
en.promotional_text: Start with personal tasks on your device. Organize plans, shopping lists and expenses, and create an encrypted backup.
en.description:
Jivie brings together tasks, home projects, events, shopping, finances and gardening. Start without an account: create and edit personal data on your device, even without an internet connection.

EVERYDAY LIFE IN ONE PLACE
• Review tasks and events on Today.
• Organize projects, phases, milestones and task deadlines.
• Make shopping lists with items and quantities.
• Record income and expenses and plan your monthly budget. Link an expense to a task.
• Plan your garden, draw beds and record seasons and plantings.
• Enable local reminders for tasks and events.
• Create an encrypted portable backup and preview its contents before restoring.
• Choose Slovenian or English and a light or dark theme.

COLLABORATE WHEN YOU CHOOSE
Connect a compatible Kanboard server with the FamilyHub plugin to synchronize devices and work together. Use a private workspace, a shared household or shared projects. Workspace permissions control access to shared records and finances. The All view brings together data from workspaces you can access.

A new account requires an administrator's code or an invitation. Signing in does not upload personal data automatically; you explicitly enable the transfer. Gardens are currently stored only on your device and included in portable backups.

NOTIFICATIONS AND REMINDERS
The notification inbox keeps track of shared activity and personal assignments. Remote push notifications require additional compatible server and mobile configuration; self-hosting alone does not provide delivery when the app is closed. Local reminders are subject to operating system limits and may be delayed.

Jivie is a free app. Hosting is not included. Synchronization is not a server backup; portable backups do not contain attachments or data the device has not downloaded.
